sn9.4:1.1: On one occasion a number of bhikkhus were dwelling among the Kosalans in a certain woodland thicket.
sn9.4:1.2: Then, when they had spent the rains there, after the three months had passed those bhikkhus set out on tour.
sn9.4:1.3: Then the devatā that inhabited that woodland thicket, not seeing those bhikkhus, lamenting, on that occasion recited this verse:
sn9.4:2.2: When I see here so many vacant seats.
sn9.4:2.3: Where have they gone, Gotama’s disciples,
sn9.4:2.4: Those splendid speakers rich in learning?”
sn9.4:3.1: When this was said, another devatā replied in verse:
sn9.4:4.1: “They’ve gone to Magadha, gone to Kosala,
sn9.4:4.2: And some are in the Vajjian land.
